recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic group portrait of four men positioned in the lower foreground, set against a large, glowing yellow theater marquee at night. The lighting is high-contrast, with warm highlights from the sign and deep shadows on the subjects' faces, creating a dramatic, moody atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects in the lower third looking in different directions
Large glowing marquee acting as a dominant light source and background
High contrast between the bright yellow sign and the dark night sky
Warm skin tones reflecting the marquee's golden illumination
coreInvariants: Dark, near-black negative space at the top and bottom edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four men arranged horizontally across the bottom half of the frame, varying in scale to suggest depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright yellow marquee sign occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright marquee, move down to the faces of the subjects, and follow their varied gazes across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black space at the very top and bottom, framing the central glow.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm yellow/gold from the marquee light.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark brown in the shadows and night sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle red for secondary text on the marquee.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow glow, low saturation in the shadows, creating a high-value contrast.

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for the primary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family with color and scale variation.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and modern feel.
Classic geometric sans-serif that fits the marquee aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of four men in dark clothing at night, lit from above by a large, glowing yellow rectangular marquee sign. The men should be looking in different directions with serious expressions. The background should be a dark night sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add geometric sans-serif text in all caps onto the marquee. The main title should be black with wide tracking. A smaller subtitle should be red, centered below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the marquee the primary light source?
Are the men positioned in the lower foreground?
Is the text all-caps and geometric?
Is there a high contrast between the yellow glow and black shadows?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic light spill from the marquee onto the subjects.
Ensure the text appears to be physically part of the marquee sign.
Verify that the negative space at the top and bottom frames the composition effectively.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast nocturnal group portrait with a dominant glowing architectural element that serves as both a light source and a typographic canvas.
